channel.title: MacDown 3000
channel.description: Updates for MacDown 3000, a Markdown editor for macOS.

item.title: MacDown 3000 3000.0.8
item.description:
This release adds folder workspaces, unified document zoom, and draggable table-column resizing, restores automatic update checks, and fixes a batch of preview-rendering, toolbar, export, and scroll-sync bugs.
### Added
- Add draggable table column resizing in the live preview: drag a column-boundary handle to resize live, double-click to reset; widths are held in memory only and reset on full preview reload or document close, with no document mutation (#451, #569) -- thanks @aseelye for the contribution! - Add folder workspaces: browse a folder of Markdown files in a hideable sidebar and open them as native macOS window tabs, via File > Open Folder… or `macdown .` (#493) -- thanks @fluxa (JM Fluxà) for the contribution! - Add unified document zoom: ⌘+ / ⌘− / ⌘0 and a toolbar preset dropdown drive one shared zoom level across every open document window, persisting across launches (#529, #518, #470, #335, #552) -- thanks @leevi2010-cursor for the contribution! - Restore automatic update checks and the Check for Updates… menu item, on Sparkle 2 with EdDSA-signed updates (#129, #556, #557)
### Changed
- Reduce "keep/discard" dialogs on external file changes: coalesce rapid write notifications, guard against re-entrant prompts, and reload silently when there are no unsaved edits, preserving caret and scroll position across reloads (#543, #550) -- thanks @Maarten-TL for the report! - Add paragraph and list-item scroll-sync reference points alongside headers/images, and follow the cursor on click and arrow-key moves (not just viewport scroll, and not while typing) when Sync Panes is on, reducing drift in header-sparse sections (#562, #563, #600) -- thanks @macnotes for the contribution!
### Fixed
- Fix heading anchor links copied from GitHub-rendered Markdown not resolving for common headings: heading IDs now strip common punctuation such as em dashes and curly quotes, lowercase Latin-1 letters, and preserve hyphen runs as GitHub does, in the preview, HTML export, and Quick Look (#503, #512) -- thanks @falcon-enoc for the report and the contribution! - Port four low-risk fixes from upstream MacDownApp/macdown#1379: fix a potential crash reaching the editor through a dangling outlet, correct Homebrew detection in the Terminal preferences pane (it never worked — `NSTask` cannot resolve a bare `brew` path), replace deprecated `-insertText:`, and remove stale xib outlet warnings (#526, #528) -- thanks @wltb (Roberto Bissanti) for the contribution! - Fix internal anchor links being lost in exported PDF by injecting PDF link annotations after export, so TOC and heading links are clickable (#504, #516) -- thanks @falcon-enoc for the report! - Fix Mermaid/Graphviz diagrams not rendering in the live preview when Syntax Highlighting is off (#533, #540) -- thanks @AgardnerAU for the report and the contribution! - Fix Mermaid/Graphviz diagrams not rendering in HTML export when "include highlighting" is off, the export-path counterpart of the preview fix above (#541, #542) - Add `img { max-width: 100% }` to the four bundled themes that lacked it (Clearness, Clearness Dark, Solarized Dark, Solarized Light), preventing wide images from overflowing the preview pane (#546, #547) -- thanks @versuchshaus (Stephan von Lingelsheim) for the contribution! - Fix bundled preview stylesheet fixes never reaching users who had already launched the app once; the user Styles directory is now an override layer with bundle fallback instead of a one-time copy (#548, #555) - Fix grouped toolbar buttons (Shift Left/Right, Bold, Italic, Underline, Heading 1-3, lists) visibly depressing but doing nothing — a regression in the click-dispatch selector lookup (#566, #567) -- thanks @massimo-cassandro for the report! thanks @stephane-bg for confirming! - Omit an empty `<thead>` from pipe tables whose header row has no content (#558, #559) -- thanks @macnotes for the contribution! - Stop copy/cut from advertising a file-representable pasteboard type, which caused Messages.app to paste an attached `.md` file instead of inline text (#571, #572) -- thanks @Paraphraser for the report!
### Known Issues
- In Settings → Rendering, the "Syntax highlighted code block" checkbox can overlap the CSS row (#579). Fixed for 3000.0.9.
